caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrating the maximum activation values across network layers for four distinct component signals under baseline conditions. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at integer intervals and no explicit unit. The vertical axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600, with major gridlines at intervals of 200 and no unit specified. Four data series are plotted: “ffn_residual” (red solid line) begins near zero, rises sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, remains between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20, then declines sharply after layer 21. “attn_residual” (orange dotted line) mirrors the ffn_residual trend but is shifted one layer to the right, rising at layer 6 and peaking around layer 21 before declining. “ffn_output” (green dash-dot line) remains near zero except for three distinct spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, each reaching approximately 800. “attn_output” (blue dashed line) remains consistently near zero across all layers, with no visible increase or peak. The legend is positioned in the upper center of the plot, identifying each line by name and style. No gridlines or additional annotations are present beyond the axes and legend.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This line chart, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” displays the maximum activation values across network layers for four distinct component signals under baseline conditions, as described in the referenced paper. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22, with linearly spaced tick marks at intervals of 5, representing discrete layer indices. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600, with linear tick marks at intervals of 200, indicating the magnitude of activation. The red solid line, labeled “ffn_residual,” begins near 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains elevated between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20, and then declines sharply after layer 20. The orange dotted line, “attn_residual,” follows a nearly identical trajectory but is shifted one layer to the right, peaking around layer 6 and maintaining high values through layer 21 before dropping. The green dash-dot line, “ffn_output,” remains near zero except for three distinct spikes: one at layer 5 reaching approximately 800, another at layer 13 peaking near 1000, and a third at layer 22 reaching approximately 1200. The blue dashed line, “attn_output,” remains consistently near zero across all layers, with no discernible peaks or increases.

raw_responses.English:
The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across network layers under baseline conditions, comparing four distinct component signals: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at integer intervals, indicating discrete layer indices. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600, with linear scaling and major tick marks at intervals of 200. The ffn_residual (red solid line) begins near 0, rises sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, remains between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20, then declines sharply after layer 21 to about 600 at layer 22. The attn_residual (orange dotted line) follows a nearly identical trajectory but is shifted one layer to the right, rising at layer 6 to ~1400, plateauing through layer 21, and dropping to ~600 at layer 22. The ffn_output (green dash-dot line) remains near 0 for most layers but exhibits sharp, isolated spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, peaking at approximately 800, 900, and 1200 respectively. The attn_output (blue dashed line) remains consistently near 0 across all layers, with no discernible increase or spike at any point.

raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm zeigt die maximalen Aktivierungswerte über 22 Schichten eines Sprachmodells unter Basisbedingungen, wobei vier Komponentensignale verglichen werden. Die x-Achse ist als „Layer“ beschriftet, mit einem linearen Skalentyp, einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 22 und ganzzahligen Tick-Beschriftungen in Einerschritten. Die y-Achse trägt die Beschriftung „Max Activation Value“, ist linear skaliert, reicht von 0 bis 1600 und zeigt Tick-Beschriftungen in 200er-Schritten. Die rote durchgezogene Linie (ffn_residual) beginnt bei 0, steigt abrupt ab Schicht 5 auf etwa 1400, bleibt zwischen 1400 und 1600 bis Schicht 20 und fällt dann auf etwa 400 bei Schicht 22 ab. Die orangefarbene gepunktete Linie (attn_residual) verläuft ähnlich, beginnt jedoch erst ab Schicht 6 mit einem Anstieg auf etwa 1400, bleibt bis Schicht 21 auf diesem Niveau und fällt dann auf etwa 600 bei Schicht 22. Die grüne strich-punkt-Linie (ffn_output) bleibt bis Schicht 4 nahe 0, steigt dann auf etwa 800 bei Schicht 5, fällt wieder ab, erreicht erneut etwa 800 bei Schicht 13 und etwa 1200 bei Schicht 22. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie (attn_output) bleibt über alle Schichten nahe 0, mit einem leichten Anstieg auf etwa 100 bei Schicht 22.
